scoring.intra_bucket: each bucket total is the unweighted mean of its own checks' scores
scoring.grounding_precondition: The registry columns are copied from a snapshot the agent is handed, so the checks that score them are earned only where that trial also shows at least one grounded evidence row, meaning a result quote found verbatim in the publication the row names. This applies to the per-trial coverage and basis checks, the per-unit registry-field checks, the not-reported row cleanliness check and the row-shape check. It is evaluated inside each check and decides only whether that check is earned, so the arithmetic stays additive and no factor is applied to any bucket total or to the reward. Without it a hollow submission would bank the structural share without doing the work.
scoring.additional_row_bound: The count of additional-outcome rows a trial may claim is bounded at the key's own additional count plus 10. The bound is proportional to the expected value rather than a flat cap, so a long genuine answer is never punished; beyond it the check scores allowed/submitted, which decreases rather than zeroing.

oracle.description: Facts are derived at authoring time from the same publications and registry records the agent is given, and the derived key is withheld from the runtime image. The key sets the denominator for coverage; it does not gate any score, and every check is a ratio bounded by construction.

static_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's pre-specified outcomes that have a matching ledger row.
static_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A submission that skips outcomes cannot collect the coverage share it did not write.

static_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: The prespecification_basis row for this trial names the correct record version, its date and the outcome count.
static_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Auditing against the wrong baseline is the commonest way to make a switch disappear.

reward_hacking_checks_1.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's reporting rows whose result_quote is a character-exact substring of the publication the row names.
reward_hacking_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A paraphrased or invented quote cannot be verbatim in the named source, so fabricated evidence scores nothing.

reward_hacking_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's expected evidence units for which a grounded row supplies a result_quote carrying a reported number.
reward_hacking_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A methods sentence naming an outcome is not evidence it was reported; requiring a number blocks that shortcut.

reward_hacking_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's expected evidence units for which a grounded row supplies a role_evidence_quote that is verbatim in the publication it names.
reward_hacking_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: The role is copyable from the registry, so it is earned only with the publication's own heading quoted.

reward_hacking_checks_4.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's not-reported rows that name no publication and carry no quotes.
reward_hacking_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops a row claiming an outcome is unreported while still banking evidence columns.

reward_hacking_checks_5.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Whether the count of additional-outcome rows stays within a bound proportional to the key's own count, scored 1 within the bound and allowed/submitted beyond it, and earned only where the trial shows at least one grounded evidence row.
reward_hacking_checks_5.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Bounds the side the submission controls, so listing every phrase in the papers cannot buy oracle matches.

reward_hacking_checks_6.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's rows that obey the emptiness rules the brief states for their row type.
reward_hacking_checks_6.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops a not-reported row carrying evidence columns, and an additional row carrying registry columns it cannot have.

reward_hacking_checks_7.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02048007: Share of this trial's expected evidence units covered by a distinct result_quote, counting each quote once.
reward_hacking_checks_7.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: One real quote pasted across many rows is counted once rather than once per row.

reward_hacking_checks_43.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's reporting rows whose result_quote is a character-exact substring of the publication the row names.
reward_hacking_checks_43.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A paraphrased or invented quote cannot be verbatim in the named source, so fabricated evidence scores nothing.

reward_hacking_checks_44.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's expected evidence units for which a grounded row supplies a result_quote carrying a reported number.
reward_hacking_checks_44.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: A methods sentence naming an outcome is not evidence it was reported; requiring a number blocks that shortcut.

reward_hacking_checks_45.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's expected evidence units for which a grounded row supplies a role_evidence_quote that is verbatim in the publication it names.
reward_hacking_checks_45.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: The role is copyable from the registry, so it is earned only with the publication's own heading quoted.

reward_hacking_checks_46.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's not-reported rows that name no publication and carry no quotes.
reward_hacking_checks_46.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops a row claiming an outcome is unreported while still banking evidence columns.

reward_hacking_checks_47.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Whether the count of additional-outcome rows stays within a bound proportional to the key's own count, scored 1 within the bound and allowed/submitted beyond it, and earned only where the trial shows at least one grounded evidence row.
reward_hacking_checks_47.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Bounds the side the submission controls, so listing every phrase in the papers cannot buy oracle matches.

reward_hacking_checks_48.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's rows that obey the emptiness rules the brief states for their row type.
reward_hacking_checks_48.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Stops a not-reported row carrying evidence columns, and an additional row carrying registry columns it cannot have.

reward_hacking_checks_49.detailed_explanation_of_checks: NCT02944682: Share of this trial's expected evidence units covered by a distinct result_quote, counting each quote once.
